text:

Sensex Today, Nifty 50 | Stock Market Live Updates: At around 12.50 pm, Sensex traded 529.46 pts or 0.73% higher at 73,058.53. Nifty 50 gained 81.05 pts or 0.36% to 22,797.25

Indian IT stocks gained traction on Wednesday, with the Nifty IT index rising over 2 per cent in early trade to 28,235.10. All constituents were trading in positive territory at the time of writing, with Coforge, Mphasis, LTM, Oracle Financial Services Software (OFSS), Persistent Systems and TCS leading the rally, rising up to 5 per cent.

Geojit Financial Services Limited, one of India’s leading investment services companies, appointed C. J. George as its Executive Chairman and Jones George as Managing Director, effective 01 October 2026, as part of its long-term succession plan.

The IPO is expected to consist largely of shares sold by existing investors, with Coca-Cola seeking a valuation of about $10 billion, the people said.

Essar Group pivots to asset-light, de-risked growth with smart investing, global partnerships, and green-energy tech for a sustainable comeback.

Kotak MF and Abakkus lead ₹830cr Axiscades stake purchase at ₹1,824 each, sending stock up ~7.5% as promoters' holding falls below 50%.

In a clarification to the stock exchanges, Sun TV Network said the news report suggesting a possible demerger of its sports division was a rumour and that it could not comment on market speculation

Top gainers: Kotak Mahindra (+2.41%), ICICI Bank (+2.37%), IndiGo (+2.08%), Shriram Finance (+1.48%)

Top losers: Apollo Hospitals (-6.56%), Max Health (-6.10%), BSE (-3.25%), Adani Enterprises (-2.94%)

Copper futures eye breakout of ₹1,432; bullish bias persists with key levels and trade targets outlined.

Amber Enterprises informed exchanges that the timeline for completion of the second tranche of investment in MoMagic Wireless Private Limited (”MoMagic”) by IL JIN Electronics (India) Limited (Formerly known as IL JIN Electronics (India) Private Limited) (“IL JIN”), a material subsidiary of the Company, through the acquisition of an additional equity stake, has been further extended, to take place on or before November 30, 2026.

JSW Cement to merge with Shiva Cement to form a unified platform, unlocking synergies and simplifying the group’s structure.

Adroit Industries debut soars 86.5% after ₹151-crore IPO, with strong subscriptions and premium listing at ₹250 on BSE.

HDFC Capital and Shalimar Corp form a ₹750-crore platform to develop 5+ million sq. ft. and 3,000 homes in UP.

MRPL: An incident involving rupture of the Cold Separator operating at high pressure in the Coker Hydrotreater Unit occurred at MRPL, resulting in a fire around noon today. The battery limits of the affected unit have been isolated, and MRPL’s emergency response and firefighting teams are actively engaged in controlling and dousing the fire. Fire has been brought under control. The firefighting operation may continue for some time as part of the safe handling of the incident. No major injuries have been reported. One minor injury has been reported and shifted to hospital and is out of danger and necessary medical attention is being provided.

360 ONE, one of India’s leading wealth and asset management firms, managing over 8,900 client families, announced the launch of Lasting Legacies: a family office handbook for How Founders Design Their Future. The publication is aimed at India’s enterprising families navigating the transition from creating wealth to sustaining it across generations.

Action Construction Equipment has been awarded an order for supply of 74 numbers of 4X4 backhoe loaders from the Border Road Organisation, Ministry of Defence (MoD). Shares surged 2.6% to ₹1,237.50 on the NSE.

Royal Orchid Hotels Ltd (ROHL), through its subsidiary Regenta Hotels Private Ltd, has announced the launch of Regenta, Bhadohi. Shares traded at ₹301.25 on the NSE, down 1%.

Sun TV Network has dismissed reports of a possible demerger of its sports division as rumours, stating that it cannot comment on market speculation.

Shares traded 12% higher at ₹621 on the NSE after hitting a fresh 52-week high of ₹663.90.

Gold and silver’s pullback makes sense on the surface: rate hike odds for October dropped sharply after Williams struck a dovish tone yesterday, saying there’s no urgency to move again so soon after September’s hike.

With three key US data releases today and NFP landing on the 2nd of October, all eyes are on the data. It’s what underpins the Fed’s decision at the October 28th meeting.

Given rising tensions around Iran, you’d expect metals to be acting as the safe haven we’re used to. Instead, they’re pushing oil higher and keeping yields elevated, with the 10-year still near 5.25%. That’s working against gold rather than for it. Higher yields raise the opportunity cost of holding a non-yielding asset, even when the fear trade would normally be bullish for it.

The wise approach here is to let this week’s data set the direction for metals.

National Entrepreneurship Network (NEN), supported by Wadhwani Foundation, has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Federation of Karnataka Chambers of Commerce and Industry (FKCCI), an apex chamber of commerce in Karnataka, to create outreach opportunities for 1,000+ growth-stage enterprises and MSMEs across the state through the Wadhwani Accelerate Program.

Under the one-year MoU, FKCCI will act as an Anchor Partner for NEN in Karnataka, leveraging its network of 135 Trade and Industry Associations and 26 District Chambers of Commerce to connect eligible enterprises (₹25 crore+ revenue) with the program.
